governance_note: Define observations, variables, entries, units, weights, and missing-data handling.
Document the baseline around which variation is measured.
State whether PCA uses original units, standardization, normalization, or weights.
Report component variance, cumulative variance, and retained-rank rationale.
Separate observation scores from variable loadings and document sign conventions.
Report reconstruction error and review observations or variables poorly represented by retained components.
Review whether extreme observations are errors, rare cases, or important transitions.
Validate reduced representation against the specific systems question and downstream use.
